title.narrative: Promoting Inclusion by strengthening CSO contribution to CRPD and SDG implementation and monitoring in China

description.narrative: Specific objective: To increase CSO capacities to empower people with disabilities, specifically women and girls with disabilities and children with intellectual disabilities, and to further their inclusion in Chinese society. To contribute to the strengthening of a network of disability focused CSOs in order to affect inclusive policy development and enhanced service delivery for people with disabilities in China.
